utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check the sign-up list and send you the exact items we still need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm the repair drive is still on for today?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — it’s still on for today. I’m checking the list now and I’ll send the needed items shortly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — if you can help with the bigger items and a quick checklist, that’d really help me keep this organized.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can take the bigger items and put together a quick checklist for you. Send me the details, and I’ll help keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I’ll send you the item list, and if you can note what goes where, that should keep us from losing track of anything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Mara, could you help me sort the donated tools with Bo while I set out the labels? That would keep the repair drive moving smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll sort the donated tools with Bo while you set out the labels. That should keep the repair drive moving along smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Mara — thank you. I’ll get the labels ready, and once Bo and you finish sorting, we can start matching everything up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you want me to bring anything for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, thanks for checking — I can bring my screwdriver set and a flashlight. If you think of anything else, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll bring tape and gloves, and I’ll let you know if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s good to hear — I can stop by the bulletin board and see who’s free to pitch in. If you need anything specific while I’m out, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep repeating the Saturday repair drive plan, and if you spot anyone free, send them my way. I’ll have the time tomorrow so I can share it with everyone again.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll keep an eye out and send anyone your way. I’ll check the bulletin board tomorrow and let you know who’s available.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira — I could still use a few more hands if anyone’s free. Even a little help would keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds like things are moving nicely—I can swing by soon and I’ll keep an eye out for extra screwdrivers too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess — that would really help. I’ll be glad to see you when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m probably a step behind too—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can help Saturday—I just need the time. Once Vik sends it, I’ll be there and ready to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh great, I’m a bit behind too—just send me the time when Vik confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can sort the donated tools first — just point me to the box.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — the box is by the garage, and if you find any extra screwdrivers, set one aside for Tess too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll sort the box by the garage and set aside an extra screwdriver for Tess if I find one.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Dane — let me double-check the time and the supply list before I confirm anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Hana — no rush, just let me know the time and what supplies I should bring when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I’ll confirm the time and send you the exact supplies list as soon as I check it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Opal — we’re still short on tape, a few screwdrivers, and gloves. If you spot anything else we need, let me know and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye out at the east end and the community bulletin board, and I’ll note any tape, screwdrivers, gloves, or other surprises I find.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Opal — that’d help a lot. I’ll keep the list updated and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 still works on my end — I’ll reach out to a couple parents and see who can cover that window. If you want, I can also help keep an eye on pickup conflicts.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Faye — that’d be really helpful. I may still be a step behind, but I’ll check on the latest repair-drive details too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — just let me know what you find, and I’ll keep coordinating the pickup side so we stay covered.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Sam — we’re organizing the repair drive at the community center this afternoon. Want me to put your name down?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — please put my name down, I’m still available to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you down for the repair drive at the community center this afternoon. Thanks, Sam!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Tess — I’m keeping the list updated, so if you think of any other supplies we’re short on, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out and shout if I hear we’re short on anything. If you’re going, swing by early; the best supplies might go fast.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Tess — I’ll get there early and keep an eye out for the good stuff.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can do that — I’ll check what’s urgent and who’s free, then report back. That should help keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira — I’m still watching the east end of the block and the community bulletin board, and I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out too and check back once I’ve got the urgent repairs and available helpers sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can bring tape and gloves—anything else you want me to grab?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s perfect, thanks—just those should help a lot. If you hear any latest updates on the drive, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Will do — I’ll let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — what still needs fixing most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring the toolbox and check what’s still missing, then we’ll tackle the biggest fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good — let’s start with the biggest fixes, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli — we’re putting together the repair drive, and the community center is where we’re coordinating. If you can help spread the word, I’d love to get you involved.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn — I can help spread the word. I’m keeping things moving one step at a time, so I appreciate the support.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Uli — I’ve got you in, and you can stop by the community center anytime after 3. I’ll fill you in there and we’ll keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll reach out to a couple of parents and see who can cover the 4:30 slot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye — that’s helpful. Once you know who can cover 4:30, just let me know the final plan.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll confirm who can cover 4:30 and get back to you as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, thanks — I’ve got the screwdriver set and a flashlight, and I’ll bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks — that covers two of the big items. I can still help sort the donated parts and grab any duct tape we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — that sounds perfect. I’ll head over with the tools and see what else needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Pia — I’m double-checking the time and what we still need before I confirm. If you have the latest list, please send it over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting the latest list, but I’m mainly worried about the bigger items and making sure we have enough space to move them. I’ll send what I have as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia — that helps. I’ll wait for your list and keep the focus on the bigger items and space for now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Bo, I’m still a bit behind, but I can come by the community center around 5 and help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — 5 works for me. Thanks for helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No problem — I’ll be there around 5 and jump in wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I may be a bit behind, but I can check on the latest and let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Noah — thanks for checking. Once you know what’s still needed, I can help line up people with the right jobs.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’ll check and see what’s still needed, then I’ll let you know. Thanks, Jules.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: 4:30 still works well for me, and I’ll keep sorting the tools and list what’s left to fix.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — 4:30 works for me too. Send me the list when you have it, and I’ll handle my part.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do — I’m on it and I’ll send you the list as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Rosa — can you confirm the repair drive is definitely still on today?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s still on today, and I’m here getting things set up now. If you’re able, I could use help sorting the donated tools or checking in with neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — what time should I tell people to show up?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
